name: Tempester n°3: pressure of sliders 2 to 4 on the FX in real time
explanation: In [routine] (Panel messages), path « Realtime, sequencer running », pressure message: the expected source was computed as 2N+8 (copy of the position computation, 2N/2N+1) instead of N+8 (N = physical slider + 2 × bank, decoder [routine]: 8-11 = pressures). Only slider 1 (N=0) came out right. The doubled value is read back only at [address], for this comparison.

edits.why: sll t4,t5,0x1 -> sll t4,t5,0: compared source N+8 instead of 2N+8
